name: transcription factor 20

function.text: TCF20 is the approved symbol for transcription factor 20. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in transcription coactivator activity; positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include developmental delay with variable intellectual impairment and behavioral abnormalities (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Definitive GenCC assertion, ClinGen. Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
